provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: This is a legend task. Each grey (original 6) shape gets a colour according to its exact cropped binary form. The six template shapes are: 2x3 rectangle ->5, plus ->3, Z zig-zag ->8, vertical 3-bar ->2, L-corner XX/.X ->4, vertical 2-bar ->9. The factory applies the episode's D4 transform to each template in the order the spec gives: reverse rows when d4>=4, then rotate clockwise d4%4 times. This yields each shape's visible orientation. The output colours become palette[c], and the shape colour becomes palette[6]. All shapes stay distinct under every D4 element, so the table stays injective. The emitted program works in visible coordinates. It finds 4-connected components of the shape colour, crops each one to a binary mask, looks the mask up in the transformed table, and repaints the component. The generator rejects scenes where different shapes share an edge, so each 4-component is exactly one placed shape. Diagonal contact is allowed, and 4-connectivity handles it. A size-based fallback mirrors the archived solver. Size does not change under D4, so the fallback stays valid. It is never needed inside the generator's domain.
draft_notes.limitations: The program uses fixed shape-to-colour constants derived from the constructor and does not learn the legend from demonstrations. That is valid because the mapping is a fixed constant of the family. A shape outside the six templates falls back to size-based colouring, as the archived solver does, and is left unchanged if its size is unknown. The fixtures agree with the uniform rule, and I found no constructor defects. The template shapes never overlap, and the edge-adjacency rejection guarantees one component per shape. Fresh scenes always use 9x9 grids. The emitted program also handles rectangular grids of any size. I have not run any tests.
draft_notes.host_review: All six silhouettes always appear in every fresh demonstration, so the arbitrary shape-to-colour table is evidenced for every query shape. Exact visible shape masks remain distinct under D4; factory specializes their local orientations and palette labels, not query content. Input 4-components remain separated; diagonal contact is allowed. Supplied fixtures unchanged.
draft_notes.host_sampler_revision: Bounded randomized backtracking places exact silhouette cells and their four-neighbour clearance, not larger bounding-box margins. Retain all six types plus 0..2 distinct duplicates on 9x9, including eight-object scenes; no count reduction or simpler replacement shapes. Distribution changes versus joint rejection; exhausted attempts raise.
